title: 第1069章  进入异域第1068章  再来两位
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 它如同一道无形的涟漪，从洞府中扩散而出，穿透层层禁制、穿透重重石壁、穿透圣渊的阴冷与腐朽，如同春风吹过荒原般拂过每一个人的灵魂。
莫山的瞳孔骤然收缩。他那干枯的身躯猛地一颤，暗青色的火焰眼瞳中浮现出一种前所未有的震动。
那股气息……是方云逸的圣人之魂。
可与他之前见过的圣人之魂不同，那道气息中蕴含的道韵，如一条原本只有十三条支流的江河，如今暴涨到十九条大河汇流。
风、水、光、暗、生、亡……六种全新道则气息在那些原本的道则之间流淌交织，如六条被注入河道的清流，让整条江河变得更加浩荡、更加磅礴。
随即，一道金色的虚影从虚空中缓缓浮现。那道虚影与方云逸的面容一模一样，清俊、威仪，带着一种睥睨天下的气度。
但它气质与方云逸的本体截然不同……本体如同一柄藏在鞘中的利刃，锋芒内敛却随时可以出鞘………
而这道圣人之魂却如一尊从亘古神话中走出的神祇，周身萦绕着十九种道则交织而成的璀璨光环，每一缕光芒都在诉说着一种天地至理。
圣人之魂悬浮在圣渊上空，它的目光扫过那些瘫倒在石阶上的弟子，扫过面色惨白却依旧挺直脊背的沐清漪，最终落在莫山那双暗青色的火焰眼瞳上。
它的声音平静而空灵，如同一道从遥远天际传来的回响，带着一种与本体截然不同的韵律，“前辈，异界那边就交给我。”
莫山看着那道金色的虚影，暗青色的火焰眼瞳中浮现出一种极其复杂的神色。
他感受到圣人之魂中蕴含的力量，感受到十九种道则交织而成的完美循环，感受到虚影中蕴含的某种超越此界认知的底蕴。
这年轻人，在短短半个月不到，竟然真的恢复圣人之魂，而且比以前更加强大。
“好。”莫山开口，声音沙哑却带着一丝如释重负，“那便去吧！本座会在此地为你撑着最后一口气。”
圣人之魂微微点头，那道金色的虚影如同被风吹拂的烟雾般朝着封印光幕飘去。
沐清漪抬头，看到那道金色虚影从自己头顶掠过，她张张嘴想要说什么，却最终只是轻声吐出四个字，“逸儿……小心。”
圣人之魂没有回头，只有一道平静得如同深潭古井的声音传入她耳中。
“娘亲，我会回来的………”
话音未落，那道金色的虚影已经飘到那道正在被鲜血不断腐蚀的裂缝前。
没有丝毫犹豫，如一道金色流光般穿入那道裂缝之中。那些正在试图愈合的金色符文在圣人之魂穿过的瞬间微微亮起一瞬，好似在辨认什么，然后便重新沉寂下去。
方云逸的圣人之魂穿过那道裂缝。在穿过封印瞬间，一股极其浓郁、裹挟着腥甜与腐败之气的灰黑色混沌雾气扑面而来，如无数条无形的触手缠绕上他的圣魂。
那股灼热的、带着腐蚀气息的元气与玄天大陆那边截然不同，每一缕都蕴含着浓郁的杀戮与吞噬之意。
圣人之魂微微凝实几分，十九种道则之力在周身无声流转，如一道无形的屏障将那些腐蚀之气尽数挡在外面。他的目光扫过眼前这片广袤而诡异的虚空……
灰黑色的混沌雾气无边无际，如同翻涌的海面般在虚空中起伏。
雾气的深处，无数道强横的气息如同暗流般涌动，有的如同山岳般沉重，有的如同毒蛇般阴冷，有的如同火焰般狂暴。
而在那些气息的最前方，六道如同烈日般璀璨的身影，正悬浮在虚空中，如同六颗不同颜色的太阳，散发着让人灵魂都在颤栗的恐怖威压。
圣人之魂飘出封印裂缝时，对面六位真神境老祖几乎是同时有所感知。
摩罗耶老祖那双灰黑色眼睛猛然转向裂缝方向，然后，他的瞳孔骤然收缩到极致。
那道金色的虚影，与在先前屠杀他们三十九尊大能的圣人之魂一模一样的虚影，竟然再次出现在他们的疆域之中。
而且，气息比上次凝实，更加强大，好似被重新浇铸过的剑胚，锋芒毕露。
墨渊狱主燃烧着暗金色火焰的双眼同样锁定那道金色虚影，手中那柄漆黑巨剑微微震颤，剑身上的赤红色纹路如同被点燃的血管般骤然亮起。
他感受到那道圣人之魂中蕴含的道则之力，一种前所未有的凝重在他心中涌起。
噬魂帝君那水银身躯表面无数面孔、同时浮现出贪婪与忌惮交织的神情。
“圣人之魂……”噬魂帝君声音从那些面孔的口中传出，层层叠叠，如同千万人同时低语，“上古时期也不过是传说之物，那边本源枯竭数万年，怎么可能还有圣人之魂出现？”
摩罗耶老祖没有开口。那灰黑色的眼眸如同两枚被岁月打磨过的黑曜石，死死锁定在悬浮于裂缝出口处的那道金色虚影之上。
感受到圣人之魂中蕴含的气息，虽然强大，却带着一种极其年轻、如初生朝阳般的生命力……那种生命力不属于任何一个活过数万年的老怪物，而是属于一个年轻人。
“此人……非常年轻。”墨渊狱主声音低沉如金属摩擦，燃烧着暗金色火焰的眼眸微微眯起，如同两柄被烧红的长刀在审视猎物。
“这圣人之魂的气息，分明只有二十余岁痕迹。一个二十余岁的年轻人，怎么可能凝聚出那边数万年来从未出现过的圣人之魂？”
“二十余岁？”金焱老祖声音如滚烫的熔岩在岩石上流淌，他那金色鳞甲覆盖的高大身躯微微前倾，头顶那对弯曲的金色长角上流转着更加炽烈的火纹。
“在那片本源枯竭的天地中，二十余岁的武者能修炼到武尊都已是凤毛麟角，此子竟然已经凝聚出圣人之魂。玄天大陆那边，必然隐藏着我们不知道的秘密。”
虚空老祖没有说话，但它那模糊面容上旋转的深紫色光晕骤然加速，如同被投入石子的深潭泛起剧烈的涟漪。

It spreads out from the cave like an invisible ripple, penetrating through layers of restrictions, layers of stone walls, and the coldness and decay of the holy abyss, blowing through everyone's soul like a spring breeze blowing through the wasteland.
Mo Shan's pupils suddenly shrank. His withered body trembled suddenly, and an unprecedented shock appeared in his dark blue flame eyes.
That aura...is Fang Yunyi's saint soul.
But unlike the saint's soul he had seen before, the Taoist charm contained in that aura was like a river that originally had only thirteen tributaries, but now it has surged to the confluence of nineteen major rivers.
Wind, water, light, darkness, life, death...the six new Taoist breaths flow and interweave among the original Taoisms, like six clear streams being poured into the river, making the entire river more majestic and majestic.
Immediately, a golden shadow slowly emerged from the void. The phantom's face was exactly the same as Fang Yunyi's, handsome and majestic, with an air of looking down on the world.
But its temperament is completely different from Fang Yunyi's body... The body is like a sharp blade hidden in a sheath, with a restrained edge but can be taken out of the sheath at any time...
But this saint's soul is like a god who stepped out of eternal mythology, surrounded by a bright halo formed by the interweaving of nineteen kinds of Tao. Every ray of light tells a kind of truth of heaven and earth.
The soul of the saint was suspended in the sky above the holy abyss. Its gaze swept over the disciples who were slumped on the stone steps, past Mu Qingyi who was pale but still had her back straight, and finally landed on Mo Shan's pair of dark blue flame eyes.
Its voice was calm and ethereal, like an echo coming from the distant sky, with a rhythm that was completely different from the original body. "Senior, leave the other world to me."
Mo Shan looked at the golden shadow, and an extremely complicated look appeared in his dark blue flame eyes.
He felt the power contained in the soul of the saint, felt the perfect cycle intertwined by the nineteen kinds of Tao, and felt some kind of foundation contained in the shadow that transcended the cognition of this world.
This young man, in less than half a month, actually recovered the soul of a saint and became stronger than before.
"Okay." Mo Shan said, his voice hoarse but with a hint of relief, "Then go! I will hold my last breath for you here."
The Saint's Soul nodded slightly, and the golden shadow floated towards the sealing light curtain like smoke blown by the wind.
Mu Qingyi looked up and saw the golden shadow passing over her head. She opened her mouth to say something, but in the end she just whispered four words, "Yier...be careful."
The saint's soul did not look back, and only a voice as calm as an ancient well reached her ears.
"Mother, I will be back..."
Before he finished speaking, the golden shadow had already floated to the crack that was being corroded by blood.
Without any hesitation, it penetrated the crack like a golden stream of light. The golden runes that were trying to heal lit up slightly for a moment when the saint's soul passed through them, as if they were recognizing something, and then fell silent again.
Fang Yunyi's saint soul passed through the crack. The moment he passed through the seal, an extremely rich, gray-black chaotic mist with a smell of fishy sweetness and corruption rushed towards his face, wrapping around his holy soul like countless invisible tentacles.
The hot, corrosive vitality was completely different from that in Xuantian Continent, and every strand contained a strong intention of killing and devouring.
The saint's soul solidified slightly, and the power of nineteen kinds of principles flowed silently around his body, like an invisible barrier that blocked out all the corrosive energy. His eyes swept across the vast and strange void in front of him...
The gray-black chaotic mist is boundless, rising and falling in the void like a surging sea.
In the depths of the mist, countless powerful auras surged like undercurrents, some as heavy as mountains, some as cold as poisonous snakes, and some as violent as flames.
And at the forefront of those auras, six figures as bright as the scorching sun were suspended in the void, like six suns of different colors, exuding a terrifying pressure that made people's souls tremble.
When the saint's soul floated out of the seal crack, the six true god realm ancestors on the opposite side felt it almost at the same time.
The gray-black eyes of Patriarch Moroye suddenly turned towards the direction of the crack, and then, his pupils suddenly shrank to the extreme.
That golden phantom, exactly the same as the soul of the saint who had massacred thirty-nine of their powerful beings, unexpectedly appeared in their territory again.
Moreover, the aura was solidified and more powerful than last time, like a sword embryo that had been recast, showing its sharp edge.
Prison Lord Mo Yuan's eyes burning with dark golden flames were also locked on the golden shadow. The black giant sword in his hand trembled slightly, and the red lines on the sword suddenly lit up like ignited blood vessels.
He felt the power of Tao contained in the saint's soul, and an unprecedented solemnity surged in his heart.
There are countless faces on the surface of the Soul-Eating Emperor's mercury body, and expressions of greed and fear appear at the same time.
"The soul of the saint..." The voice of the Soul-eating Emperor came from the mouths of those faces, layer by layer, like tens of thousands of people whispering at the same time, "It was just a legendary thing in ancient times. The source over there has been exhausted for tens of thousands of years, how can there be still the soul of the saint?"
Patriarch Moroye did not speak. Those gray-black eyes were like two obsidian stones polished by time, locked firmly on the golden shadow suspended at the exit of the crack.
I feel the aura contained in the saint's soul. Although it is powerful, it carries a vitality that is extremely young, like the rising sun... That kind of vitality does not belong to any old monster who has lived for tens of thousands of years, but to a young man.
"This person... is very young." Prison Master Mo Yuan's voice was as low as metal friction, and his eyes burning with dark golden flames were slightly narrowed, like two long red-hot knives examining the prey.
"The aura of this saint's soul clearly only has traces of being in his twenties. How can a young man in his twenties condense the soul of a saint that has never appeared over there for tens of thousands of years?"
"More than twenty years old?" Ancestor Jin Yan's voice was like hot lava flowing on the rocks. His tall body covered with golden scales leaned forward slightly, and more intense fire patterns flowed on the pair of curved golden horns above his head.
"In that world where the origins are exhausted, warriors over twenty years old who can cultivate to the level of martial master are very rare. This boy has actually condensed the soul of a saint. There must be secrets hidden in Xuantian Continent that we don't know."
The Void Ancestor did not speak, but the dark purple halo swirling on its blurry face suddenly accelerated, like violent ripples rising from a deep pool of stones thrown into it.
